import ast, hashlib, json, struct
from pathlib import Path

source = Path("/home/shanshan/trt-asc/src/TileRT-Ascend/tilert/models/glm_5_2_ascend/reference_weights.py")
source_bytes = source.read_bytes()
tree = ast.parse(source_bytes.decode())
compile(tree, str(source), "exec")
imports = [
    item.module if isinstance(item, ast.ImportFrom)
    else ",".join(alias.name for alias in item.names)
    for item in ast.walk(tree)
    if isinstance(item, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom))
]
root = Path("/data/shanshan/trt-asc/models/GLM-5.2-w4a8c8")
metadata_names = [
    "config.json", "quant_model_description.json",
    "quant_model_weights.safetensors.index.json",
]
index = json.loads((root / metadata_names[2]).read_text())["weight_map"]
headers = {}
payload_bytes = 0

def location(name):
    path = root / index[name]
    if path not in headers:
        with path.open("rb") as stream:
            size = struct.unpack("<Q", stream.read(8))[0]
            headers[path] = size + 8, json.loads(stream.read(size))
    base, header = headers[path]
    return path, base, header[name]

def segment(name, start, count):
    global payload_bytes
    path, base, header = location(name)
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        stream.seek(base + header["data_offsets"][0] + start)
        data = stream.read(count)
    payload_bytes += len(data)
    assert len(data) == count
    return data

def f32(value):
    return struct.unpack("<f", struct.pack("<f", value))[0]

def scalar(name, row, column=0):
    _, _, header = location(name)
    columns = header["shape"][1] if len(header["shape"]) == 2 else 1
    return struct.unpack("<f", segment(name, (row * columns + column) * 4, 4))[0]

def decode(byte):
    low, high = byte % 16, byte // 16
    return low if low < 8 else low - 16, high if high < 8 else high - 16

for byte in range(256):
    low, high = decode(byte)
    assert -8 <= low <= 7 and -8 <= high <= 7
    assert ((low & 15) | ((high & 15) << 4)) == byte
assert [decode(byte) for byte in (0, 127, 128, 255, 135)] == [
    (0, 0), (-1, 7), (0, -8), (-1, -1), (7, -8)
]

errors = []
rows_checked = []
for layer, expert in [(3, 0), (77, 255)]:
    for projection in ["gate_proj", "up_proj", "down_proj"]:
        prefix = f"model.layers.{layer}.mlp.experts.{expert}.{projection}"
        _, _, header = location(prefix + ".weight")
        packed_rows, columns = header["shape"]
        _, _, bias_header = location(prefix + ".scale_bias")
        groups = bias_header["shape"][1]
        width = columns // groups
        for row in (0, 1, packed_rows * 2 - 2, packed_rows * 2 - 1):
            packed = segment(prefix + ".weight", (row // 2) * columns, columns)
            values = [decode(byte)[row % 2] for byte in packed]
            scale = scalar(prefix + ".weight_scale", row)
            assert scalar(prefix + ".weight_offset", row) == 0
            row_error = 0.0
            for group in range(groups):
                integer_sum = sum(values[group * width:(group + 1) * width])
                expected = f32(f32(integer_sum * scale) * 8)
                actual = scalar(prefix + ".scale_bias", row, group)
                error = abs(expected - actual)
                assert error <= 1e-8 + 1e-5 * abs(expected)
                errors.append(error)
                row_error = max(row_error, error)
            rows_checked.append({
                "prefix": prefix, "logical_output_row": row,
                "input_groups": groups, "group_width": width,
                "max_scale_bias_absolute_error": row_error,
            })

result = {
    "scope": "stdlib raw-byte format/correction and source AST audit only",
    "source": str(source),
    "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest(),
    "metadata_sha256": {
        name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        for name in metadata_names
    },
    "ast_compile": "pass",
    "imports": imports,
    "lines_over_79": [
        [number, len(line)]
        for number, line in enumerate(source_bytes.decode().splitlines(), 1)
        if len(line) > 79
    ],
    "nibble_patterns": 256,
    "weight_rows": len(rows_checked),
    "scale_bias_checks": len(errors),
    "max_scale_bias_absolute_error": max(errors),
    "tensor_payload_bytes_read": payload_bytes,
    "rows_checked": rows_checked,
    "torch_module_executed": False,
    "torch_numerical_parity": "pending",
    "npu_executed": False,
    "c8_128_channel_quantization_order": "pending NPU calibration",
    "result": "pass",
}
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
